radio.apacik_ortada: Is it obvious to an average user that this is AI?
radio.ilk_etkilesim: Is the notification given at first interaction?
radio.erisilebilirlik: Does the notification meet accessibility requirements? (visual/hearing impaired etc.)
radio.acik_ayirt: Is the notification clear and distinguishable?
radio.200_token: Does the content contain text longer than 200 tokens?
radio.birlikte_calisabilirlik: Can the detection mechanism interoperate by 2 February 2027?
radio.cok_katmanli: Are there at least two layers of marking? (metadata + watermark)
radio.dijital_imza: Is the metadata digitally signed and timestamped?
radio.kamuya_acik: Is the detection solution publicly available and free?
radio.standart_duzenleme: Is the content just an assistive edit? (exempt if semantics unchanged)
radio.mevcudiyet: Does the content resemble an existing person, object, place or event?
radio.ilk_maruziyet: Is the label clearly visible at first exposure?
radio.sesli_bildirim: If audio content, is there an audio disclaimer?
radio.sanatsal_etiket: In artistic works, is the label non-intrusive?
radio.kamu_kapsam: Is the public interest scope clear? (politics, health, justice etc.)
radio.kanun_yetki: Is the use authorised by law for crime detection/prevention?
radio.zaman: Is the exposure real-time or after the fact?
radio.yetkili_inceleme: Does the reviewer have authority to approve, modify or reject the content?
radio.editoryal_kim: Is there a real person or legal entity with editorial responsibility?

checkbox.gercekci: Is the content realistic? (like real person/object/event)
checkbox.kamu_yarari: Is it on a matter of public interest?
checkbox.editoryal_sorumlu: Is there a person with editorial responsibility?
checkbox.bildirim_dt: Are users notified of emotion recognition?
checkbox.biyometrik_dt: Is biometric data processed? (voice tone, facial expression etc.)

hukuki.gizlilik_1_metin: Our system collects: (a) account information (name, email, username), (b) audit records (AI type, client name, result, date), (c) session information (IP, login time), (d) technical logs.
hukuki.gizlilik_2_metin: Collected data is used solely for: providing the service, generating audit reports, fulfilling legal obligations, and improving the service. Your data is not shared with third parties for commercial purposes.
hukuki.gizlilik_3_metin: Audit records are stored as long as your account is active. Upon account deletion, data is anonymized or deleted within 30 days. Legal retention periods apply where required by law.
hukuki.gizlilik_4_metin: Data is transmitted over encrypted connection (HTTPS). Database access is protected by authentication. Passwords are hashed with bcrypt. Daily automatic backups are taken.
hukuki.gizlilik_5_metin: Under GDPR and KVKK, you have the right to: access, rectify, delete (right to be forgotten), object to processing, and data portability. Contact us to exercise these rights.
hukuki.kvkk_1_metin: Under the Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 (KVKK), the data controller is Veraxio Technology Inc.
hukuki.kvkk_2_metin: Identity data (name, surname), contact data (email, phone), customer transaction data (audit records), transaction security data (IP, logs).
hukuki.kvkk_3_metin: Performance of contract, fulfillment of legal obligations, service quality improvement, security provision.
hukuki.kvkk_4_metin: Your personal data is not transferred to third parties without your explicit consent. May be shared with authorized public institutions when legally required.
hukuki.kvkk_5_metin: Your data is collected electronically through the web application, automatically or manually.
hukuki.kvkk_6_metin: You have the right to: learn whether your data is processed, request information about it, learn the purpose, request correction if incomplete/incorrect, request deletion, learn to whom it was transferred.
hukuki.kvkk_basvuru_bilgi: Applications can be sent to kvkk@veraxio.com. Response within 30 days at latest.
hukuki.kullanim_1_metin: Veraxio is a SaaS platform providing EU AI Act and KVKK compliance audits. The service includes automated audit tools and reporting.
hukuki.kullanim_2_metin: The user is obligated to: provide accurate information, ensure account security, use the service lawfully, and not violate the rights of others.
hukuki.kullanim_3_metin: All software, design, and content of the platform belong to Veraxio. Users obtain only a usage right for service purposes.
hukuki.kullanim_4_metin: Reports generated by the system are technical audit outputs and do not constitute legal advice. Consult a qualified lawyer for final legal assessment.
hukuki.kullanim_sorumluluk: Veraxio cannot be held liable for indirect damages arising from service use.
hukuki.dpa_ozet: This DPA governs the relationship between the data processor and controller under GDPR Article 28 and KVKK Article 9.
hukuki.dpa_1_metin: Veraxio, as the party processing personal data on behalf of the customer, processes data solely within the scope of the agreement.
hukuki.dpa_2_metin: Processing is carried out throughout the contract term and only within the scope of the service. Upon contract termination, data is returned or deleted.
hukuki.dpa_3_metin: Veraxio applies: encryption, access control, logging, regular backups, personnel training, and similar technical and organizational measures.
hukuki.dpa_4_metin: Veraxio obtains customer approval before using sub-processors. Sub-processors are subject to the same data protection obligations.
hukuki.footer: These texts are informational. Consult your lawyer for legal advice.
